					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'post' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_post_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_post_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_post_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_post_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'post' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SQL:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SQL:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'post' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance

					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'post' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SQL:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'post' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495),

            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)

) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'

SELECT   wp_posts.*
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND wp_posts.post_name IN ('header') AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (13)
) AND wp_posts.post_type = 'wp_template_part' AND ((wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 1

            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)

  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SQL:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)

) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY  ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.800749), 
          (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) ASC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'

                     FROM wp_events_places ep

                     WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID
                     LIMIT 1)) ASC

            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance,

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (17,18,20)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.800749),
                    (SELECT pl.location
                     FROM wp_events_places ep
                     JOIN wp_place_locations pl ON ep.place_id = pl.post_id
                     WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID
                     LIMIT 1)) ASC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)

  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'

SQL:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.800749),
                    (SELECT pl.location
                     FROM wp_events_places ep
                     JOIN wp_place_locations pl ON ep.place_id = pl.post_id
                     WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID
                     LIMIT 1)) ASC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

                     LIMIT 1)) ASC
					 LIMIT 0, 1

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

    [post_type] => post
    [distance] => 200

SQL:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SQL:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.800749),
        (SELECT pl.location
          FROM wp_events_places ep
          JOIN wp_place_locations pl ON ep.place_id = pl.post_id
          WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID
          LIMIT 1)) ASC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.800749),
        (SELECT pl.location
          FROM wp_events_places ep
          JOIN wp_place_locations pl ON ep.place_id = pl.post_id
          WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID
          LIMIT 1)) ASC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

GET Request:
Array
(
    [orderby] => distance
    [post_type] => post
    [distance] => 200
)

SQL:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.800749),
        (SELECT pl.location
          FROM wp_events_places ep
          JOIN wp_place_locations pl ON ep.place_id = pl.post_id
          WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID
          LIMIT 1)) ASC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SQL:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.800749),
        (SELECT pl.location
          FROM wp_events_places ep
          JOIN wp_place_locations pl ON ep.place_id = pl.post_id
          WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID
          LIMIT 1)) ASC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

SQL:
SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations WHERE post_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS distance, 
            ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.8007495), 
            (SELECT location FROM wp_place_locations pl_event 
            LEFT JOIN wp_events_places ep ON ep.place_id = pl_event.post_id
            WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID LIMIT 1)) AS e_distance
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (16)
) AND ((wp_posts.post_type = 'event' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')) OR (wp_posts.post_type = 'place' AND (wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' 
OR wp_posts.post_status = 'private')))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.post_type, wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.800749),
        (SELECT pl.location
          FROM wp_events_places ep
          JOIN wp_place_locations pl ON ep.place_id = pl.post_id
          WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID
          LIMIT 1)) ASC
					 LIMIT 0, 10

					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id)
					 WHERE 1=1  AND wp_posts.post_name IN ('footer') AND ( 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (13)
) AND wp_posts.post_type = 'wp_template_part' AND ((wp_posts.post_status = 'publish'))
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(38.045496, 23.800749),
        (SELECT pl.location
          FROM wp_events_places ep
          JOIN wp_place_locations pl ON ep.place_id = pl.post_id
          WHERE ep.event_id = wp_posts.ID
          LIMIT 1)) ASC
					 LIMIT 0, 1
